exampleConventions: Example input merges onto a base published post; references resolve as "<ref:key>".

blog-post-not-published-at-source.action: These posts were drafts or pending at the source and were not imported, so nothing unpublished went live. Recreate any you still want in Business Manager > Blog.
blog-post-not-published-at-source.resolutionEvidence: Each listed post exists on Wix or is confirmed unwanted.

blog-post-title-missing.action: These posts have no title and were not imported. Add them in Business Manager > Blog if still wanted.
blog-post-title-missing.resolutionEvidence: Each listed post exists on Wix or is confirmed unwanted.

blog-post-date-invalid.action: Requires Import Operator: these posts have a publish date that is not a date.
blog-post-date-invalid.importOperatorPrompt: Re-read the listed posts (GET /wp/v2/posts/<id>?context=edit), check date_gmt, and rerun the post import for these ids.

blog-category-not-landed.action: Requires Import Operator: the blog category of these posts was not imported yet, so the posts wait.
blog-category-not-landed.importOperatorPrompt: Run or rerun the blog category import, then rerun the post import for these ids.
blog-category-not-landed.resolutionEvidence: Each listed post is imported with its categories.

blog-tag-not-landed.action: Requires Import Operator: a blog tag of these posts was not imported yet, so the posts wait.
blog-tag-not-landed.importOperatorPrompt: Run or rerun the blog tag import, then rerun the post import for these ids.
blog-tag-not-landed.resolutionEvidence: Each listed post is imported with its tags.

fieldMappings.reason: The edit-context title (entities decoded). Only posts published at the source are imported.

choice.name: blog-post-unpublished
choice.reason: A draft or pending post would go live: the post composite publishes. Store P: 3 drafts, 3 pending. The cutover task lists them.

fieldMappings.reason: The rendered HTML goes to the post composite, which converts it to Wix rich content and imports inline images.

verification.unverifiableReason: Converted to Ricos by the post composite (convertHtmlToRichContent); its read-back checks the document.

fieldMappings.reason: The percent-decoded source slug keeps the post URL.
Blog category ids in source order, resolved per record by the dependency gate (blog/post dependencyReferenceFields categoryIds[]). A category not landed yet holds the post until it lands.

verification.unverifiableReason: Gate-supplied reference; verified by the dependency-gate receipt, not the builder read-back.

choice.name: blog-category-not-landed
choice.value: hold the post until the category lands
choice.default: hold the post until the category lands
choice.reason: A post without its category is a silent change; the loop waits per record.

referencePolicy.orphan: the post waits for its category (per-record); a category never imported is a dependency cutover item

fieldMappings.reason: Blog tag ids. Store P: 40 posts carry tags.
The featured image becomes the hero image (full size, from the media record).

verification.unverifiableReason: Imported by the post composite from the media library record; a post whose image is not ready is deferred.

fieldMappings.reason: Every post is attributed to the site owner member (read-only lookup); no member is created per WordPress author. The author id is archived.

choice.name: blog-post-author
choice.reason: Creating members from WordPress users is a member-import decision, not a post field. The cutover task lets the merchant change the writer in Business Manager > Blog.

fieldMappings.reason: Every other post field (sticky, format, comment status, yoast, links) is kept in the private source-archive collection.

verification.unverifiableReason: Packed archive items are verified by the archive step read-back.

choice.name: leftover-fields
choice.reason: No native Wix field holds them; nothing is dropped silently.
